what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Peru in all host countries combined: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 113900 asylum seekers from Peru.
The United States hosts the largest share, 58.4%, followed by Italy, Spain and Canada.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Peru with Sendero Luminoso from 1995 to 1999 and from 2007 to 2010, and an interstate armed conflict between Ecuador and Peru in 1995.
The fact pack records no armed conflict in Peru in recent years, so it does not say why the number of asylum seekers grew.

when.text: UNHCR's series starts in 2000 at 2435 asylum seekers.
The figure reached its highest point, 119061, at the end of 2024, and the main years of displacement in the data are 2023 to 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took.
These are year-end totals of asylum seekers summed over every host country; refugees from Peru are counted separately.
